$description: CommandBar (platform/patterns/CommandBar): the bar over a collection (owner, 2026-10-14): one white framed bar (3A), fixed at the top of the content, its bars stacked with the selection bar under them; the shared commands (BarActions): the danger color of a ghost command and the divider before the danger commands.

command-bar-gap.$description: Command bar: the space between its bars (the action bar, the find bar, the selection bar).

command-bar-sticky-background.$description: Command bar, fixed at the top: the page surface behind the bars, so the content scrolling under them does not show between them.

command-bar-sticky-z-index.$description: Command bar, fixed at the top: drawn over the content that scrolls under it.

command-bar-padding-block-end.$description: Command bar, fixed at the top: the space under the last bar, before the content.

command-bar-background.$description: Command bar: the bar is white (3A), never tinted while rows are selected.

command-bar-border-color.$description: Command bar: the frame of the bar (3A).

command-bar-padding-block.$description: Command bar: the space above and below the controls in the bar.

command-bar-padding-inline.$description: Command bar: the space before and after the controls in the bar.

command-bar-count-text.$description: Command bar: the count at the end ("24 assets"), in the data font.

command-bar-danger-text.$description: Command bar and selection bar: a danger command (Delete), a ghost button in the danger color.

command-bar-danger-hover-text.$description: Command bar and selection bar: a danger command while hovered (the ghost hover fill, the danger color kept).

command-bar-divider-height.$description: Command bar and selection bar: the divider before the danger commands (and before Select all and Clear), as tall as a toolbar icon’s room.

command-bar-divider-color.$description: Command bar and selection bar: the divider’s color.

command-bar-divider-width.$description: Command bar and selection bar: the divider’s width.
